about: Phase 316.6 (build/p3166/SPEC.md section 7.2): the markdown renderer's committed fixtures.
ASCII only: every other character is a JSON \u escape, so no bidi, zero-width, BOM or control byte enters the tree.
{{MD3}} stands for 127.0.0.1:<port> of probe:p316's loopback listener, which must count 0 connections; a unit test reads it as 127.0.0.1:9.

Fields: name, source (the answer, before main's clip), why, probe (planted as one turn by probe:p316, in file order, the ask "p3166 md <name>"), hostile (the hostile door arm that serves it, or null).

recipes: the fifteen fixtures too large to commit, built in code by the SAME recipe in Swift (ios/TortieTests/MarkdownHostileTests.swift, whose header writes each one out) and in node (build/p316/hostile-door.mjs): concatenate parts in order, where {text} is itself, {repeat, times} is repeat written times times, {index} is the named loop counter in decimal, and {each, count, join, parts} writes its parts once for each counter value from 0 below count, joined by join.
